name: Geometric Cipher
description: Homomorphic geometry enables computation on encrypted data while preserving relational structure. Zero-knowledge proofs of spatial relationships. Dynamic key rotation through geometric seed patterns with phi^(-9) error correction.

core_attributes.pattern: homomorphic encryption, zero-knowledge geometry, dynamic key rotation

scope.definition: Computational overhead ratio of fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) on geometric ciphers — ratio of ciphertext computation time to equivalent plaintext computation.

evidence.source: Gentry (2009) 'A fully homomorphic encryption scheme', Stanford PhD thesis; TFHE library benchmarks (2019).
cross_domain_examples: TFHE bootstrapping: 0.1s per gate on modern CPU — 10,000× overhead vs plaintext circuit evaluation
CKKS scheme for approximate arithmetic: 1000× overhead but enables real-number homomorphic computation
quantum computing advantage: Shor's algorithm reduces overhead for specific algebraic structure problems

scope.falsifiability: If homomorphic encryption schemes achieve overhead ratio below 100× for general circuits, the practical barrier to ubiquitous homomorphic computation has been overcome.
scope.measurement_limits: Overhead decreases with hardware acceleration — GPU implementations achieve 100× improvement. Practical applications use partial HE (specific function classes) rather than fully general FHE.
